definitions.gloss: splish-splashing; light, gentle splashing of water
definitions.explanation: An onomatopoeic word describing the soft, rhythmic sound of water splashing gently — as when wading in shallow water, playing in a puddle, or water lapping against something.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水|みず}たまり→水たまり：19427_mizutamari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ちゃぷちゃぷ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The children are splish-splashing through the puddles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ちゃぷちゃぷ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{寄|よ}せる→打ち寄せる：28677_uchiyoseru⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧がした。
examples.english: There was the sound of waves gently lapping against the shore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ちゃぷちゃぷ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れて→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちよかった→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: When I got in the hot spring, the water swirled gently every time I moved, and it felt wonderful.

notes:
An onomatopoeia for gentle, repetitive splashing. The reduplicated form ちゃぷちゃぷ emphasizes the ongoing, rhythmic nature of the sound.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ before a verb, or alone as an adverb:
- ちゃぷちゃぷ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to splash along
- ちゃぷちゃぷ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make splashing sounds

RELATED WATER ONOMATOPOEIA:
- ⟦ざぶん→ざぶん：29089_zabun⟧: a single large splash
- ⟦ざぶざぶ→ざぶざぶ：05993_zabuzabu⟧: wading through water with big splashes
- ⟦{滴|しずく}→滴：18536_shizuku⟧⟦たらたら→たらたら：28988_taratara⟧: water dripping steadily
